Job Description
 About the Role
 We are looking for a .NET Backend Developer to join our team!
We strongly believe that “Ideas power everything!”, so here you’ll find the context where all your initiatives not only will be heard, but really appreciated!
We're building a large-scale, enterprise-grade web platform on a modular microservice architecture. As a backend engineer, you'll own the full lifecycle of domain services — from data modelling and business logic through API design, messaging contracts, database migrations, and production deployment.
You'll work in a multi-vendor setup alongside DevOps, architecture, and product teams.
 Responsibilities
 Design, build, test, and operate microservices following a read/write service-pair pattern (read-only delivery APIs + write-capable update/ingestion services)
 Implement event-driven communication between services
 Own your domain end-to-end: schema design, API contracts, persistence, messaging, and production monitoring
 Contribute to shared platform libraries and tooling
 Document architectural decisions and service designs for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Required Technical Skills And Experience
 C# / .NET 8 – Web API development, modern C# features (records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, async/await best practices)
 Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
 Microservice architecture - clear separation of concerns across layered services (controller → service → repository)
 Entity Framework Core - code-first migrations, specification pattern, repository abstraction
 Authentication & Authorization - JWT validation, Azure AD / Entra ID, OIDC
 Third-party API integrations (DAM systems, CRM/marketing platforms, email dispatch)
 Nice To Have
 Event-driven messaging - publishing and consuming messages on a service bus (MassTransit, NServiceBus, or similar), contract-first design, idempotency
 Azure - AKS (Kubernetes), Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Table Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity, Azure Functions (isolated worker model), Azure AI Search
 Experience with CDN cache invalidation (e.g. Akamai FastPurge API)
 Redis caching strategies
 Roslyn Analyzers / Code Fix Providers
 PDF generation libraries
 Other Requirements
 Experience working in a client-facing role, interacting with both technical and non-technical stake-holders
 Experience working in agile, multi-vendor environments
 Must be fluent in English, written and verbal communications
